home.title: Notes taking shape between code, tools, and people.
home.intro: Some questions keep returning after a project is over: how a command changes a workflow, how a boundary reveals a system's character, and how new tools change human judgment. I keep those traces here.

about.title: About
about.heading: Microboat
about.intro: This is closer to a half-open studio: some essays are polished, some judgments still have rough edges.
paragraphs: I am Microboat. I spend my days writing code, shaping systems, studying tools, and being corrected by all three.
I am drawn to questions that still smell like the workshop: why an abstraction saves you, why a button misleads you, and why stronger automation makes human judgment matter more.
If something here gives you a usable thought, or simply sends you back to your own problem with better eyes, the site is doing its job.
